categories_description: An entry can belong to several categories. They are there to group your entries by theme.
categories_empty_description: No category has been created yet.
categories_manage_delete_dialog_message: The entries concerned will be detached from it. No entry will be deleted.
categories_manage_description: If you rename a category, the entries using it follow to its new address. If you delete it, those entries are simply detached: not one of them is erased.
categories_manage_field_slug_taken: This address is already in use.
categories_slug_empty_description: No entry belongs to this category yet.
categories_slug_unknown_description: No category goes by this name.
common_empty_wiki_description: This wiki is empty: start by creating the first entry.
connection_status_failure_conflict: The online backup changed on another device. It is up to you to choose what to keep.
connection_status_failure_missing: Automatic sending failed: this server does not hold any backup.
connection_status_failure_network: Automatic sending failed: the server is not responding.
connection_status_failure_refused: Automatic sending refused: the server's password has changed.
connection_status_failure_server: Automatic sending failed: the server ran into an error.
connection_status_failure_unreadable: Automatic sending failed: the server's response could not be understood.
connection_status_failure_unsupported: Automatic sending failed: this address no longer leads to a backup server.
connection_status_offline_pending: Offline. Your changes will go out as soon as the connection returns.
dashboard_activity_description: Number of entries edited per month, over a year.
dashboard_description: The state of your wiki as the site shows it right now, including the changes saved only on this device.
dashboard_missing_empty: No red link: everything cited exists.
data_clear_description: This deletes every page, every category and the whole feed from this device, all at once and with no way back. Download a copy first, unless you really want to start from zero.
data_clear_spares_intro: Your settings stay where they are: the name of the universe, its colour, its featured pages and your language are left untouched. To put them back to their default, open
data_description: What you write stays on this device, and nowhere else. Nobody else sees it, but nothing protects it either: if you clear your browser's data, or if you change computer, everything is lost. So do make a copy, either in a file you keep somewhere safe, or online so you can find your wiki again from another device.
data_reset_dialog_message: Every page, every category and the whole feed will be deleted from this device. Whatever has not been copied elsewhere will be lost. Your settings, for their part, will be kept.
data_reset_feedback: The content of your wiki has been cleared from this device. Your settings have been kept.
demo_confirm_message: Your current pages will be replaced with those of the demonstration, identity of the wiki included, and the interface will switch to English. Anything not copied elsewhere will be lost.
demo_confirm_title: Replace your wiki with the demonstration?
demo_description: A wiki of about twenty pages, its categories, its chronology and its feed, to see what the site looks like with content in it. Its fiction is written in English, and the interface switches to English with it. You may set the interface back afterwards; the fiction itself will not be translated. The content is loaded like a backup: it replaces everything, and the page reloads to apply it. The illustrations of these pages are hosted elsewhere and need a connection.
demo_error: The demonstration content could not be loaded. Your wiki has not changed.
edit_empty_description: It may have been deleted, or its address may have changed.
entry_form_aliases_hint: Search takes them into account, but they do not create an extra page.
entry_form_dates_hint: Add one date per landmark: birth and death, founding, the occurrence of an event. Each date places the page on the timeline and appears in its infobox. You can write « 2043-06-12 », « June 2043 » or even « The third winter ».
entry_form_delete_confirm_message: The page will be permanently deleted.
entry_form_slug_taken_hint: Another page already uses this address. A number will be appended.
entry_form_summary_placeholder: One or two sentences. They appear below the title, in listings and in search.
entry_form_title_placeholder: Name of the character, place, event...
entry_form_unsaved_confirm: Some changes have not been saved. Leave the editor anyway?
entry_image_fields_hint: Paste the address of an image online. If you have access to the site's files, you can also drop the image in the media folder, then give its path here.
entry_picker_hint: Search for an existing page, or type a title that does not exist yet to create a red link.
entry_picker_input_label: Title of the page to link
error_fallback_message: The requested path does not match any known entry.
error_heading_not_found: This page is not in the archives
featured_pages_description: The first page takes the large card on the home page, the next two take the side cards.
file_backup_copy_error: Your browser refused the copy. Use the download instead: you will get the same file.
file_backup_copy_success: Backup copied. Paste it wherever you want to keep it.
file_backup_download_description: The file contains everything you see on the site, drafts included. Downloading it changes nothing in your wiki: it is a copy, not a move.
file_backup_download_success: Backup downloaded. Your wiki has not changed.
file_backup_file_ready: {name} is ready. Run the restore to replace your pages with those in the file.
file_backup_import_error: This content is not a valid backup. Your wiki was not changed.
file_backup_intro: This section gathers your whole wiki into a single file, downloaded onto this device. Nothing is sent over the internet. Keep this file safe: it will give you back your pages, here or on another computer.
file_backup_paste_label: Or paste the content of a backup
file_backup_paste_placeholder: Paste the content of a backup file here.
file_backup_replace_message: Your current pages will be replaced with those from the backup. Anything not copied elsewhere will be lost.
file_backup_restore_description: Use this section to go back to a backup, or to recover work done on another device. Careful: the replacement is total. The site will show exactly what the file contains, and your current pages will disappear. Download a copy first if you have work in progress.
file_backup_restored_summary: Backup restored: {entries}, {categories}, and {live} in the feed.
live_composer_body_placeholder: One or two sentences. Markdown accepted.
live_composer_pin_checkbox: Pin at the top of the feed
live_delete_dialog_message: The entry will be permanently deleted.
live_empty_description: No feed entry matches this filter.
live_how_it_works_p1: A feed entry is short and timestamped. When an event deserves a proper write up, link the entry to a page: the « Read the full page » link then appears just below.
live_how_it_works_p2: An entry at « Alert » severity shows a banner across the whole site for twenty-four hours.
live_latest_prefix: The latest one dates back to
live_meta_description: Feed of the events under way in {universe}.
live_storage_description: Every publication is saved in this browser: it appears here immediately, but stays on this device until you have backed it up.
local_content_empty_intro: Nothing is stored on this device yet.
local_content_empty_outro: to get started, or restore a backup below.
local_content_identity_intro: Name, signature, description, logo and featured pages, set from
local_content_storage_warning: The space available on this device is nearly full. Download a copy of your wiki, then clear it to free up room.
markdown_editor_placeholder: Write the page. Type / to insert a block.
markdown_missing_page_title: This page does not exist yet
remote_backup_autopush_hint_never_synced: Wait until you have synchronised once by hand before turning this option on. Otherwise, the first automatic send would overwrite a backup you have never seen.
remote_backup_autopush_hint_synced: Your changes are sent a few seconds after you stop writing. While you are offline, they wait for the connection to return. If the server refuses a send because the online backup changed in the meantime, nothing is overwritten by force: you are warned here, and you are the one who chooses what to keep.
remote_backup_autopush_label: Send automatically when the connection returns
remote_backup_conditional_note: This server keeps track of the backup's versions. If it has changed since your last read, the send is refused instead of overwriting it.
remote_backup_directions_note: In both directions, the replacement is total. When you send, your pages overwrite the server's backup. When you restore, the backup overwrites your pages.
remote_backup_failure_conflict: The online backup has changed since your last read, likely from another device.
remote_backup_failure_missing: This server does not contain any backup yet.
remote_backup_failure_network: The server is not responding. Check the address, and that the server is online.
remote_backup_failure_server: The server ran into an error on its side. Try again later.
remote_backup_failure_unreadable: The server's response could not be understood. It may not be a backup server.
remote_backup_failure_unsupported: This address does not lead to a backup server. Check it with the person who installed the server.
remote_backup_forget_confirm_message: You will need to enter the address and password again to reconnect to this server. Your pages are left untouched.
remote_backup_forgotten: Server forgotten. Your wiki keeps working on this device.
remote_backup_intro: This option is entirely optional, and most of the time unnecessary: the backup file above is enough in almost every case. A server is only there to let you find your pages on another device without passing a file by hand. You then need a server of your own, one that someone will have installed for that purpose. As long as this field stays empty, nothing leaves this device.
remote_backup_overwrite_confirm_message: Changes made on the server since your last read will be permanently lost.
remote_backup_restore_confirm_message: Your pages will be replaced with those from the backup. Anything you have not sent will be lost.
remote_backup_restored_summary: Wiki restored: {entries}, {categories}, and {live} in the feed.
remote_backup_secret_hint: This password is kept in plain text on this device and encrypts nothing: it only stops a stranger from writing to your server. So do not use a password you rely on elsewhere.
remote_backup_secret_placeholder: Leave empty if the server does not ask for one
remote_backup_send_confirm_message: Your pages will completely replace the server's backup.
remote_backup_send_confirm_message_empty: Your wiki is empty: the send will therefore replace the server's backup with an empty wiki.
remote_backup_storage_error_suffix: The server stays usable, but it will be forgotten when leaving this page.
remote_backup_sync_stale: You have changed your wiki since the last synchronisation. Send your pages to update the backup, or restore the backup to abandon those changes.
remote_backup_sync_synced: Online backup up to date: it holds exactly your current pages.
remote_backup_sync_unknown: You have never synchronised this device with this server yet.
remote_backup_test_empty: Connection successful. This server does not contain any backup yet.
remote_backup_test_success: Connection successful. The online backup contains {count}.
remote_backup_unconditional_note: This server does not keep track of the backup's versions. Every send overwrites the previous one, without warning.
remote_backup_unsaved_url: Address not saved: testing the connection will save it
remote_backup_url_hint: Enter, exactly as is, the address given to you by the person who installed the server.
remote_config_write_error: Could not save the server configuration: {error}
search_dialog_placeholder: Search a character, a place, an event...
settings_description: The name of your universe and how it presents itself. These fields appear in the header, on the home page, and whenever someone shares a link to your wiki.
settings_form_accent_hint: It colors article links, buttons and the header logo.
settings_form_description_placeholder: A few words about your universe, shown when a link is shared.
settings_form_language_hint: Changes the language of the interface across the whole site. The page reloads to apply it.
settings_form_logo_hint: The address of an image, online or in the site's files. Leave empty to keep the initial.
settings_form_saved_intro: Saved. Remember to make a copy from
settings_reset_confirm_message: The name, the description, the logo, the colour, the featured pages and the language will go back to their original state. Your pages, for their part, are not affected.
settings_reset_description: This puts this page back to its original state: the name of the universe, its description, its logo, its colour, the pages it puts forward and the language of the site.
settings_reset_spares_intro: Your content is left alone: your pages, your categories and the feed stay where they are. To clear them, open
timeline_description_end: . An entry appears once per date it carries. Those with no date at all do not show up here.
timeline_empty_description: Add a reference date to an entry to see it appear here.
timeline_meta_description: The dated events of {universe}, in order.
wiki_description_filter_hint: Filter by category, by status or by keyword.
wiki_no_match_description: Broaden or reset the filters to find your entries again.
wiki_slug_backlinks_empty: No entry points to this address.
wiki_slug_draft_label: Draft: the content is still incomplete
wiki_slug_unwritten_description: Another entry points to this address, but the page has not been written yet. That is the point of a red link: it flags what is left to do.
wiki_slug_unwritten_title: This entry does not exist yet
wiki_storage_write_error: Could not save your changes: the browser storage is full. Download a backup so nothing is lost. ({error})
